name: Mt. Pyre
lines:
Memories of my darling Skitty...
My eyes flood just thinking about it.

This used to be a desolate place.
The ground had holes here and there,
and I used to fall in!

I make a habit of coming here after
work at least once a day.
I’m afraid of forgetting my Pokémon.

I wonder why cemeteries
are built...

I’m so old that all my tears
have dried up completely.
But my memories flood my
mind all the time.

Because I loved my Pokémon very much,
I spent a lot of money to get a good spot.
You know, you can measure the depth of
love by the money you spend.
